violations.text: Raw animal foods shrimp were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods dumplings in prep unit #1. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Proper food storage reviewed with PIC. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026

Prepared crab meat was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

ROP tuna and tilapia was observed thawing with ROP packaging still intact. Tuna was observed at 37 DF and tilapia was observed at 36 DF. All fish was taken completely out of packaging at the time of inspection. Proper thawing methods reviewed. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

Bowls are being used as scoops in containers of dry ingredients and sauce. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

The floor in the walk-in freezer area has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils ice machine were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machine was emptied and placed out of order at the time of inspection. Establishment is not to use ice machine until it is properly cleaned and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

Fried rice was observed held at 115 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Per PIC, fried rice was left out for a small amount of time before being placed in the holder. Rice was reheated to above 165 DF and placed back into holder at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

Fried Tempura shrimp was observed held at 52 degrees Fahrenheit in the top of prep unit #1. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food was voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Establishment is to monitor food temperature to ensure food is staying at 41 DF or less. PIC instructed too not keep food above the fill lines in prep unit. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

Various food was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

ROP tuna and tilapia was observed thawing with ROP packaging still intact. ROP fish was observed between 32-37 DF. All fish was taken completely out of packaging at the time of inspection. Proper thawing methods reviewed with PIC. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

Knives were observed being stored in between prep unit and prep table at the time of inspection. Utensils must be stored in a clean dry location that prevents any kind of contamination. All knives were moved to the ware washing area at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

Bowls are being used as scoops in containers of dry ingredients and sauce. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

The floor in the walk-in freezer area, behind the grease trap/3-bay sink, and underneath units in the kitchen has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

Observed food prep sink with air-break. A plumbing system shall be installed to prevent backflow of a liquid or gas contaminant into the water supply by providing an air gap or installing an approved backflow prevention device. New Violation. Correct By: 03/25/2026
